candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method defaultModel to class Select
candidates.description:
Move method defaultModel to org.apache.tapestry5.corelib.components.Select
Rationale: The defaultModel() method is closely related to the functionality of the Select class, which deals with selecting items from a list of values using a select element. The method's purpose is to create a default SelectModel based on the value type of the select component, which directly ties into how the Select class operates. Moving this method to the Select class enhances cohesion, as it centralizes the logic for model creation within the class that handles the select component's behavior.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method beginRender to class Field
candidates.description:
Move method beginRender to org.apache.tapestry5.Field
Rationale: The method beginRender(MarkupWriter writer) is closely related to the rendering logic of a field. Since the method checks if the field is disabled and conditionally adds a 'disabled' attribute to the writer, it directly pertains to the state and behavior of the field itself. Moving the method to the Field class aligns the rendering logic with the component it is responsible for, ensuring better encapsulation and maintainability. Additionally, rendering concerns should ideally reside within the class that represents the data being rendered.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method buildComponentRequestHandler to class TapestryModule

Since the method directly utilizes the pipelineBuilder from TapestryModule, it fits within the context of TapestryModule, which is responsible for configuring and managing various components and services in Tapestry. Moving this method to TapestryModule enhances cohesion and aligns it with the module's responsibilities.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method onActionFromClear to class FormSupport
candidates.description:
